capability.title: Menu Catalog
capability.description: Category tabs with live dish counts, multi-select dietary filters, price and name sorting, and a responsive dish-card grid with photography, description, price and hover interaction. Section h2, category h3 per panel, dish names h4.
useWhen: A menu page needs its full dish catalog grouped by category with filtering and sorting
avoidWhen: A page only highlights a few seasonal dishes without a complete catalog
